You can now mute your own microphone in the middle of a meeting, and the mini window's coach tab shows every suggestion so far instead of only the one on screen.

- **Mic mute.** A new mic button sits beside pause in the meeting window, in the mini window's row, and in the main title bar (`Shift+Cmd+M` / `Ctrl+Shift+M`, also in the Meeting menu). While muted, nothing said on this computer's microphone is recorded or transcribed, and the other side carries on as before. The button turns red and the mic chip reads 已靜音 / Muted. Unlike pause, the meeting clock keeps running and the recording stays one continuous timeline.
- Muted speech is not counted by delivery coaching, voice typing still hears the microphone while the meeting is muted, and the "is this meeting over?" prompt does not appear while muted.
- The microphone's transcription session keeps running on silence while muted, so muted time still counts toward transcription usage.
- **Coach tab in the mini window.** It used to show only the current suggestion and was an empty row the rest of the time. It is now a scrollable list of the meeting's suggestions, the current one highlighted and earlier ones dimmed, each with the time it appeared. The mini window no longer changes height as suggestions come and go.
